Travel back to the [home page](/).

## Feedback

I welcome feedback on the accessibility of this site and the educational materials I create. Please let me know if you encounter any accessibility barriers by using the [contact page](contact.qmd) and I'll do my best to respond promptly.

## Accessibility practices

This site has been designed with the following features in mind:

- A color palette that meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards for contrast
- Alternative text for all informative images
- Readable font faces, chosen to avoid impostor letter shapes and mirroring
- A table of contents in the blog post sidebar for easier navigation

I'm not a web developer, but I try to regularly audit the site for accessibility failures and fix what I can, using tools such as the [WAVE Web Accessibility Evaluation Tool](https://wave.webaim.org/).
